pay_detail: You do not get paid. Each project can receive a microgrant of $1,000 to $5,000 to carry it out. The money pays for the project, not a wage to you.
name: Youth Climate Action Fund microgrants
what_you_do: Young residents design a climate project and apply for a $1,000 to $5,000 microgrant to carry it out. City staff help with ideas before you apply.
who_can_apply: Aurora residents ages 15 to 24. At least two young people must lead each project.
deadline_text: Applications ran Aug 24 to Oct 16, 2026 (the FAQ says Oct 5). A second round may come if projects finish on time. No date is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Questions: youthservdiv@aurora.il.us.
notes: 10 to 50 projects share $50,000. Funds go out by Nov 13, 2026, and projects end by Apr 15, 2027. Ages up to 24 can apply. Next round not posted.
